description.from: Define the shared adapter interface every source adapter implements: discovery, streaming extraction (files can exceed 100MB), skip counters, read-only access to source data, and safe snapshotting of SQLite/WAL sources. Done when the contract is typed, tested, and documented.
description.to: The Adapter trait contract for the Rust library: discovery, session opening, streaming extraction (with the per-agent adapters), skip counters, read-only access, safe SQLite/WAL snapshotting. Specs first: features/04_adapters.
